security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, when the DecodeUnitComp (DecodeUnitComp.scala:126-127) RS1==x0 detection logic fails to apply VSETOpType.setVlmax to the vsetvli micro-op's fuOpType — either because the RS1 field extraction from the instruction word is incorrect, the RS1===0 comparison is masked by an earlier branch (e.g., dest===0 && src1===0 at line 124 short-circuits without also checking isVsetvli vs isVsetvl), or the setVlmax bit (bit 0) is overwritten downstream — then VsetModule (Vsetu.scala:91-93) computes normalVL = Mux(0 > vlmax, vlmax, 0) = 0, yielding CSR[vl] = 0 instead of vlmax.
security_spec.summary: vsetvli with rs1==x0 must force vl=vlmax per spec PR #1262; if the decode-stage RS1==x0 detection fails, X[0]=0 produces vl=0 instead of vlmax, silently disabling the entire vector unit (all subsequent vector insts execute 0 iterations)
